name: DeepSeek-V3
attention_variant: MLA (multi-head latent attention), q_lora_rank 1536, kv_lora_rank 512, 128 heads expanded from latent
license: DeepSeek Model License (bespoke; permits commercial use, restricts some uses)
notes: MLA, and the reason this record matters for serving: the resident KV is a 512-rank latent, not per-head K/V. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 61 layers x (kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64) x 2 bytes (bf16) = 61 x 576 x 2 = 70,272 B/token (68.6 KiB). Do NOT apply the standard GQA formula here: num_layers x num_kv_heads x head_dim x 2 x 2 would give 61 x 128 x 128 x 2 x 2 = 4,000,256 B/token, overstating by 57x. config.json lists num_key_value_heads 128 because the latent is expanded to 128 heads at attention time, not because 128 head-pairs are cached. Params: vendor card states 671B total / 37B activated; the HF safetensors total is 684.53B (includes the MTP layer, num_nextn_predict_layers 1). Our own arithmetic from config gives 670.9B total / 37.4B active, which matches the vendor active figure to 1%. MoE: 256 routed + 1 always-on shared expert, 8 per token, first_k_dense_replace 3 (layers 0-2 are dense, not MoE), n_group 8 / topk_group 4 grouped routing. Context: max_position_embeddings 163840 via YaRN rope_scaling factor 40 over an original 4096, rope_theta 10000. Serving note: bf16 weights are ~1.37 TB, so this is an FP8/FP4-only proposition in practice.
